'''DecipherCon 1999 Allegiances''' was a Star Wars CCG side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (11–14 November 1999, Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia). Decipher posted two four-player table sheets.<ref name="dc99sw10_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Allegiances Multi Deck Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525035447/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99sw10_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: Allegiances Multi Deck Format], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001031220355/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/SW10_2.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Side event (Allegiances: Multi-Deck Format)
* '''Format:''' [[Allegiances: Multi-Deck Format]]<ref name="dc99-thu">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Thursday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20021005063305/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/thu_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Friday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Date:''' Thursday 11 November 1999, 6 p.m.–11 p.m.; Friday 12 November 1999, 5 p.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday 14 November 1999, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.
* '''Site:''' Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia

A Sunday heat is on the schedule. A Sunday score sheet is not preserved.<ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule: Sunday], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive]</ref>
